description: Source code for AidlSensorHalWrapper class implementing sensor hardware abstraction layer using Android AIDL, including connection management, sensor data polling, and direct channel configuration.

classes.name: AidlSensorsCallback
classes.description: Callback class implementing sensor connection/disconnection notifications.

methods.name: serviceDied
methods.description: Handles sensor HAL death and attempts to reconnect.

methods.name: AidlSensorsCallback::onDynamicSensorsConnected
methods.description: Called when sensors are connected, converts SensorInfo to sensor_t and notifies callback.

methods.name: AidlSensorsCallback::onDynamicSensorsDisconnected
methods.description: Called when sensors are disconnected, notifies callback.

methods.name: AidlSensorHalWrapper::connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the sensor HAL service, initializes message queues and callback.

methods.name: AidlSensorHalWrapper::prepareForReconnect
methods.description: Prepares the wrapper for reconnection by waking the event queue.

methods.name: AidlSensorHalWrapper::poll
methods.description: Stub method for polling sensor data, returns 0.

methods.name: AidlSensorHalWrapper::pollFmq
methods.description: Reads sensor events from message queue, handles waiting and reconnection logic.

methods.name: AidlSensorHalWrapper::registerDirectChannel
methods.description: Registers a direct memory channel for sensor data.

methods.name: AidlSensorHalWrapper::configureDirectChannel
methods.description: Configures a direct memory channel for sensor reporting.

methods.name: AidlSensorHalWrapper::writeWakeLockHandled
methods.description: Notifies that wake lock handling is complete.
